spanish: y verá el sacerdote, y he aquí cubrió la tsaráat toda su carne, y purificará la plaga; todo él se volvió blanco; puro él.

findings.issue: Common noun הַצָּרַעַת (H6883, feminine singular) is left as the transliterated lemma tsaráat instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens: priest sees, behold it covered all his flesh, he purifies the affliction, all of him turned white, he is pure.
